full: Use case product-mockup. Generate ONE new full-product photograph of luxury sunglasses, entire object including both unfolded temples and curved ear tips completely inside frame with 12% margins, three-quarter front-left view elevated enough to see full structure, pale neutral gray seamless studio ground, landscape 3:2. Input1 is eyewear DESIGN inspiration only: substantial softly squared honey-amber/dark espresso tortoiseshell polished acetate frame, brown gradient lenses, warm champagne hinge and discreet horizontal temple inset. Input2 is the REQUIRED DIAMOND SETTING reference: copy its perfectly smooth round aperture seating and completely exposed diamond crown. Rebuild the temple inset: seven round brilliant diamonds per outside temple, each sitting inside a clean circular recess in a flat smooth champagne metal plate. Absolutely ZERO prongs, claws, beads, dots, knobs, projections, screws, or raised metal between or over the diamonds. Plate is smooth and flat between circles, retention concealed underneath. No visible metal touching or crossing a diamond crown/table. Preserve balanced luxury proportions and rich translucent organic amber marbling. Photorealistic photographic acetate microtexture, flawless smooth polish, optical brown gradient lenses with subtle front studio reflections and slight transparency, precise brilliant facets with restrained spectral fire. 100mm product lens, full object sharp focus, controlled softboxes and dynamic strip highlights. No logo, text or labels. Only one pair of sunglasses, not a collage.
